resolved.title: Robert Harris on Roman General Agrippa
resolved._description: Augustus was Rome's first Emperor. But who made his empire possible? Behind the throne stood Marcus Agrippa, the brilliant general whose victories secured the Roman world yet whose name was consciously erased from the record by his erstwhile great friend. In this very special episode Tristan Hughes is joined by bestselling author Robert Harris to uncover the remarkable life of Agrippa. resolved._description: This week, Alex continues her attachment style series and dives into fearful, or disorganized, attachment.
